description: This file provides Spanish translations for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining localized messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is below the minimum required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable items has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching for results.
